title: TrimUI Brick Music Player
description:
An efficient music player for the TrimUI Brick - My latest project, written in Golang, using SDL2. It is supposed to look like a Zune (but it has its differences still) and supports large song libraries, with search support (on-screen keyboard) and playlists as well! There is also support for using Bluetooth audio output (it can be a little finicky sometimes but otherwise it works pretty well!)

Check it out if you are looking for a nice, easy-on-the-battery-life Music Player for the TrimUI Brick (binaries available on the Releases page)

title: Zetla
description: Local-first AI chat app for Android - bring your own API keys, offline Vosk voice input, web search via Exa MCP, and a bundled CPython sandbox for running code. Kotlin/Compose with a C++ core.

title: WASM-inspired CPU with Toolchain
description:
A simple 32-bit stack processor implemented for the Tang Nano 9K FPGA. I have, since the initial implementation, also worked on developing a C89 toolchain (passes 76% of https://c-testsuite.github.io/) and an assembler + linker for the same, with ELF binary support.

It is in no way complete yet, and I do not intend to work on it for a while, but it was a fun learning experience no less.

title: AutoTypeset
description: I spent my last 2 semesters of B.Tech interning, and so never had the chance to write handwritten notes for the subjects then. So I mostly generated LaTeX notes with the reference textbooks... Fast-forward to now, AutoTypeset takes my handwritten PDF notes as input, and outputs LaTeX PDFs. And it works great!
